items.note: disabling automatic macOS and critical-update installation is the user's action; the campaign never changes it

items.checked_by: recorded (no gate): a restart is a reboot, detected by the boot UUID and resumable; the scheduled power events are read by `pmset -g sched` (owner decisions section 14: restart hazards)
items.note: automatic restarts by an OS update are excluded by the previous item; a scheduled restart / shutdown / sleep is for the operator to cancel (a user action; the campaign never changes it)

items.checked_by: existing gates: require_ac and preflight ac_power; AC at every sample (sleep channels)
existing: supervised caffeinate -i -m -s (execute / resume); the sleep channels K / S / L detect any sleep (qualification runtimes need a CLEAN assessment); the lid is a user action
items.note: caffeinate cannot stop lid-close (clamshell) sleep: keep the lid open, on AC, for the whole run

items.checked_by: existing gate: preflight free_disk_ge_2GiB (MIN_FREE_DISK 2147483648 bytes, ratification item 23)
items.note: a failed probe is NOT_READY (fail closed)

items.checked_by: new gate (brief 50): QUAL_MIN_FREE_BYTES 7516192768 bytes before the verifier's start and each heavy phase, and before the mutant runner's start and each target run
existing gate: free_memory_ge_min (FREE_MEM_MIN_BYTES 2147483648, provisional; R-FREE and its attainability at the qualification)
existing gate: preflight boot_uuid_recorded; the journal and every identity carry it (a reboot is CONSUMED_INTERRUPTED)

existing check: check_platform at preflight, execute, every resume and every computing mode (RC2 / DR2); re-pinned at the freeze from the qualification host (code/mbs308_repin.py platform --write-platform)
existing gate: host_exclusive (EXCL_CPU_PCT 25.0, EXCL_ALLOW; R-EXCL-PCT / R-ALLOW at the freeze)
items.note: quit the listed apps (a user action); a process is never allow-listed by hand; no `ps` reading is UNKNOWN (the gate itself refuses)
READY needs a positive reading: no pidfile, or a recorded process that is positively dead

actions: the lid open and the host on AC for the whole run
no concurrent sandbox-heavy work on the host
automatic macOS / critical-update installation disabled by the user
operator_actions.line: one ledger line by the operator / coordinator for the run, quoting the user's statement and its time

owner_section14.covered_by: the driver's preflight gate `ac_power` and `require_ac` in pre_marker_common (execute and every resume refuse before the marker / before the attempt counter moves)

no accepted text makes the lid a gate (protocol 8.1: caffeinate cannot stop lid-close sleep; keeping the lid open is a user action): --host-report reads, read-only, the lid (ioreg AppleClamshellState) and the sleep / displaysleep / disksleep timers (pmset -g) and whether the sleep channels K / S / L are available; after the start any sleep is detected by K / S / L and recorded in the sealed record
owner_section14.operator_checklist: the lid is open and the host is on AC before the launch and stays so until the seal

owner_section14.covered_by: the supervised `caffeinate -i -m -s -w <pid>` started by keep_awake in pre_marker_common (re-spawned whenever it dies; every death and re-spawn recorded durably and in the sealed record)

the driver's preflight gate `no_automatic_os_install` (DR2 c: AutomaticallyInstallMacOSUpdates and CriticalUpdateInstall must be 0; a missing key is enabled); read-only: disabling them is the user's action
owner_section14.item: automatic macOS/critical-update installation disabled as required

owner_section14.covered_by: update-triggered restarts are excluded by the gate `no_automatic_os_install`; --host-report reads, read-only, `pmset -g` autorestart and the scheduled power events (`pmset -g sched`: a scheduled restart / shutdown / sleep is a hazard); any restart is detected by the boot UUID and classified CONSUMED_INTERRUPTED (resumable within the frozen budget), never a result
owner_section14.operator_checklist: no restart, shutdown or sleep is scheduled and no update restart is pending from the launch to the seal

owner_section14.covered_by: the driver's preflight gate `thermal_pressure_0` (recorded after the marker, never gating)
the driver's preflight gate `free_disk_ge_2GiB` (MIN_FREE_DISK; a failed probe fails closed)

check_platform (the pinned interpreter and libpython with their sha256, the OS build, the architecture: the qualification host) and check_identity (the qualified worktree, git dir, common dir and branch)
the driver's preflight gate `boot_uuid_recorded`; the journal and every process identity carry the boot UUID
check_platform at preflight, execute, every resume and every computing mode (RC2 / DR2)

check_seal_preconditions (committer / author identity; the object store writable, a private index and a trial commit object with the current configuration; the branch ref; the git dir writable), check_clean (the tree clean, ignored files included; no index / HEAD / branch / packed-refs lock), check_not_evaluated (no campaign lockfile), and the driver's own fixed git environment (GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; every durable write passes core.fsync / core.fsyncMethod explicitly); no accepted text names a further git setting

the preflight gate `no_other_campaign_job` (a LIVE pidfile refuses), check_not_evaluated (a journal that is not a stale pre-marker intent refuses; campaign lockfiles refuse), check_helpers and check_grant (the driver and helper bytes are the granted, pinned bytes), the O_EXCL lock

check_grant (HEAD is the grant commit on the chain freeze -> qualification -> review -> grant as the grant names it; the driver sha256 and the freeze manifest bound), check_clean and check_bindings (every pinned file equals its blob at HEAD)
check_not_evaluated (any ref under refs/p5y-k5-cell308-mbs-r1/ other than a stale pre-marker intent refuses: CONSUMED) and the marker's compare-and-swap from zero
check_not_evaluated (the pending-result ref refuses: CONSUMED; a result in the tree, in history or in the spool refuses: TARGET_ARTIFACT_EXISTS)

check_not_evaluated (no MB-S marker, journal attempt, checkpoint, pending result or result exists: zero successor target evaluations) and check_mbr1_state (MB r1's recorded state exactly: cell 308 consumed once, by MB r1)
